thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (rolling 5m error rate 18%). Backpressure metrics show scheduler queue depth rising across batcher pools. Paging oncall.

oncall-amber: I'm on it. Seeing sustained queue growth on scheduler-pool-3 and pool-4. Latency percentiles climbing, gateway timeouts around 10s+ from API gateway. Are any deploys recent? :thinking_face:

sanjay (SRE): No deploys in the last 2 hours. Preliminary logs show batcher accept loop is slow; many requests stuck waiting for KV-cache hits. Head-of-line blocking pattern: a few huge sequences (~2048 tokens) are monopolizing batch windows.

maria (runtime): Yup, the long sequences are forcing large continuous batching windows. The runtime is accumulating KV pages and hitting GC/eviction thrash. We're seeing worker thread stalls. This is causing downstream timeouts at the gateway.

leo (platform): Dashboard shows scheduler queue depth: pool-3 780 -> 1500 in 15m. Worker CPU and GPU enq wait rising. Autoscaler hasn't started new nodes because node quota is near soft limit.

oncall-amber: Customers flagged via alerts: 6 support tickets for 5 distinct orgs, mainly >95th% latency and 502/504. James can you surface a quick sticky note to support? Nina, product - any tiered customers impacted? 

james (support): Notified the support oncall. Early reports: two enterprise customers on Dedicated pools seeing errors for heavy generation endpoints. Escalated to account owners.

nina (product): Thank you. Please mention we are investigating and routing around impacted pools.

sanjay (SRE): Immediate mitigation plan:
1) Gate large sequences: push a routing rule to the gateway to reject/short-circuit requests with tokens > 1200 to fail-fast (429) for now.
2) Reduce max_batch_size on scheduler-pool-3 & pool-4 to 8 -> lowers head-of-line packing.
3) Evict long-wait requests older than 6s from the front of the queue to break HOL.
4) Route new traffic to pool-1 and pool-2 (less loaded) and to dedicated fallback pool if capacity.

maria (runtime): I'll apply (2) + (3) now. Command I'm running:
```
# reduce batch size
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://ctrl-api.internal/v1/pools/pool-3/config -d '{"max_batch_size":8}'

# run queue-evict
kubectl exec -it scheduler-pool-3-0 -- /bin/sh -c "python3 tools/queue_evict.py --older-than 6"
```

oncall-amber: Go for it. Also enable the preemptive-eviction feature flag on pool-4.

maria (runtime): preemptive-eviction enabled on pool-4. Running the commands now.

incident-bot: System: autoscaler event: requested additional nodes for us-west-2, pending quota approval.

leo (platform): I'm filing a quick request to cloud quotas. In parallel I'm spinning up an emergency scheduler replicaset in us-west-2 using any-spot fallback: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/scheduler-pool-1`.

sanjay (SRE): Gateway throttling step: enable path-level throttles for /v1/generate for burst=200 sustained=50 to limit new inflow. Also disable streaming responses to reduce per-request state build-up.

oncall-amber: Maria, any noticeable change after eviction and batch-size change?

maria (runtime): Queue depth started to drop within 60s; pool-3 depth 1500 -> 420. Error rate decreased to ~9% but not back to baseline. Some long-tail timeouts still happening. Streaming toggle in place, helps memory pressure.

james (support): Customer-facing update drafted: "We're investigating elevated errors and have applied traffic controls and mitigation steps. Some requests may return 429. We'll update in 30 minutes." Sending now.

nina (product): Good. Tell enterprise customers we have a dedicated engineer assigned and will follow up with a timeline.

sanjay (SRE): Next steps for live mitigation:
- Continue routing new traffic to less loaded pools and fallback small model variant `redwood-small-quant` for non-sensitive orgs.
- Apply temporary TTL eviction at 6s for queues across affected pools.
- If error rate doesn't drop to <2% in 15m, we will enable full route-failover to dedicated fallback region (us-east-1).

maria (runtime): Implemented TTL eviction across pool-3/4 and switched non-critical traffic to `redwood-small-quant`. Observed error rate now 3.1% and p95 latency improving.

oncall-amber: Good progress. Do we have any customers still impacted? James?

james (support): Two enterprise customers reported intermittent 502s but both are seeing improvement after the switch. I'm keeping them updated.

leo (platform): Autoscaler quota approved, new nodes coming up. Once they complete, we can restore original batch sizes and re-enable streaming gradually.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: scheduler-pool-1 scaled from 2 -> 6 replicas. New pods registering.

sanjay (SRE): Triage note: root cause summary—large sequence requests created oversized batch windows, causing KV cache pressure and worker stalls. Head-of-line blocking prevented smaller requests from being served, producing gateway timeouts and 5xx spikes.

nina (product): Thanks. Can we capture a short incident severity and customer impact note? Suggest Sev2: partial outage for generation endpoints limited to us-west-2 with degraded performance; several enterprise customers affected intermittently.

oncall-amber: Agreed Sev2. I'll hand the incident to morning oncall in 30m. Amber -> handing off to Sam (oncall) in the incident log. Key action items for postmortem:
- Add per-request token-length gating at ingress (configurable) to prevent oversized sequences from monopolizing batch windows.
- Improve autoscaler visibility and raise soft quota thresholds for critical pools.
- Add HOL detection and automatic preemptive eviction earlier (threshold <4s) to break queues sooner.
- Add customer routing policy for emergency failover.

sanjay (SRE): I'll file the postmortem and include logs, metrics, and exact mitigation timeline. Assigned to: sanjay, maria, leo. ETA draft in 48h.

oncall-amber: Wrapping up live thread. Current status: errors down to 1.9%, queue depths stabilizing, new nodes booting. Support will continue customer comms. Passing to next oncall: @sam (oncall) - takeover in 30m. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Note: incident-channel pinged oncall rotation for handoff.
